support: Business-hours-only email support (9am-5pm weekdays), typical response time 24-48 hours, no phone or chat support
refund_policy: Refunds only for annual plans, prorated at 50% after the first 30 days, no refund on monthly plans
uptime_documentation: No public status page; uptime figures self-reported in a quarterly PDF summary emailed to customers on request
notes: No SLA credit program; outages compensated case-by-case at vendor discretion
